description: Atreia Atlas layers: the page's own set of toggles, in the order the layer panel lists them (Miguel's brief, 28 Oct 2026; Places added for named spots with capture mode; in-game icons and Areas added 28 Oct at Miguel's request). Each line says what the layer shows on our map, not a fact about the game. image is the in-game icon, cut from Miguel's own map captures (pages/aetherium/icons/game/); a layer whose in-game icon we have not confirmed yet keeps our own icon (pages/aetherium/icons/atlas-layers.svg). Hidden Cubes are left off on purpose (Miguel, 29 Oct 2026): their spots only come from reading the game client, which we do not do. minZoomPx is the drawn map width (CSS pixels) from which a layer that comes in big numbers shows, so the map never needs number bubbles. landmark layers are drawn with their name under the icon, like the in-game map, and never clustered.
